publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for Organization logo relationship management and public logo delivery.
Domain service contract for primary Organization logo upload, replacement, deletion, relationship reads, and public delivery.

dependsOn.description: Organization logo relationships store and stream real image bytes through the governed asset service.
Logo management validates Organization tenant/object ownership through the Organization Core service.
Tenant-admin logo routes require an active tenant session context.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing stable public logo URLs, primary-logo replacement semantics, placeholder behavior, cache headers, or asset-read delegation can break public branding, downstream rendering, and cache invalidation assumptions.
